title: Verdict Core public proof matrix

rows.requirement: Hard eligibility checks run before advisory ranking and excluded candidates cannot be reintroduced.
rows.public_wording: Verdict filters candidates through hard eligibility gates before advisory ranking.
rows.gap: No live provider behavior is implied by this local contract evidence.

rows.requirement: Malformed, contradictory, or missing runtime observations are represented explicitly; the cache may serve stale reports within its configured stale window.
rows.public_wording: The local adapter handles malformed and contradictory observations explicitly; cached reports can remain stale during the grace window and must not be described as universally fail-closed for protected work.
rows.gap: AvailabilityCache serves stale reports within TTL plus 30 seconds and may retain a stale report after refresh failure. EligibilityGate.evaluate does not independently reject old eligible/READY reports. A protected-work freshness check and regression are needed for a universal fail-closed claim.

rows.requirement: Capability and runtime passports preserve exact identity, provenance, freshness, authority, and limitations.
rows.public_wording: Passports separate declared, observed, and negotiated evidence for exact executable identities.
rows.gap: The passport contract does not itself execute a protocol or certify an external service.

rows.requirement: Runtime compatibility reports expose deterministic status, evidence states, limitations, remediation, and secret-safe identity.
rows.public_wording: Verdict can render a deterministic, fail-closed compatibility matrix from existing runtime passport evidence.
rows.gap: Live discovery, handshakes, probes, and protocol adapters remain separate work.

rows.requirement: Policy decisions and fallback transitions are versioned, deterministic, and legal before execution.
rows.public_wording: Routing policy and legal transition checks are deterministic and versioned.
rows.gap: A policy contract is not evidence that a particular provider route is healthy.

rows.requirement: Decision, execution, and outcome evidence is durable, scoped, tamper-evident, and privacy-safe.

evidence.locator: dependency-free serialized receipt and manifest verifier
round-trip, field tamper, redaction, missing evidence, and independent verification

rows.verification: python -m pytest -q tests/test_proof_receipts.py tests/test_durable_receipts.py tests/test_security.py tests/test_evidence.py
rows.public_wording: Receipt contracts support scoped durable evidence, independent verification, claim history, redaction, and integrity checks.
rows.gap: Operators still need deployment-specific retention, access-control, and key-management decisions.

rows.requirement: The standalone evaluation/promotion controller gates its recorded promotion decisions on evidence and supports rollback.
rows.public_wording: The standalone evaluation controller checks evidence for its promotion decisions and supports rollback; adaptive ranker canary activation is not bound to that approval.
rows.gap: AdaptiveRanker canary_active uses VERSIONED plus rollback_enabled, without enforcement linkage to EvaluationController promotion approval. Wire and test the two before claiming all adaptive recommendations remain shadow-only pending evaluation.

rows.requirement: A deterministic demo exercises hard eligibility and can run without provider credentials or network access.
rows.public_wording: The repository includes a credential-free deterministic quickstart fixture with explicit exclusions.
rows.gap: The fixture is not a live-provider or production deployment demonstration.

rows.requirement: Benchmark fixture structure and digests are stable; timing results are observed, while bundles are byte-identical for identical collected artifact bytes.
rows.public_wording: Fixture structure and digests can be checked locally; measured benchmark timings and threshold verdicts are not byte-deterministic. Evidence bundles are reproducible when collected artifact bytes are identical.
rows.gap: Generated timestamps and nanosecond timings vary between benchmark runs; the byte-identical bundle test assumes identical collected evidence bytes. Neither proves live provider quality.

rows.requirement: Repository CI includes lint, type, test, dependency, static security, and CodeQL checks.

evidence.locator: test, lint, security, type-check, install-smoke, build jobs

rows.verification: Inspect workflow definitions and require all branch-protection checks to pass on the release PR.
rows.public_wording: Repository CI and security workflow definitions include checks for lint, types, tests, dependencies, static security, and CodeQL.
rows.gap: Workflow definitions do not show a successful exact-SHA run or mandatory tag-release dependency on all security/privacy checks; exact PR/release check records must be verified separately.

rows.requirement: The catalog qualification record distinguishes catalog membership from liveness and eligibility.
rows.verification: Validate the checked-in JSON artifacts and inspect their recorded hashes, aggregate consistency, and limitations; raw-payload digest replay is not available.
rows.public_wording: The recorded catalog snapshots are bounded observations, not proof that every listed route is runnable.
rows.gap: The snapshots are historical and partial; they do not certify current provider availability.

rows.requirement: Quantified latency, throughput, memory, adoption, or quality claims have reproducible public evidence before publication.
rows.verification: For each metric, locate a reproducible artifact with definition, date, environment, and raw result before changing status.
rows.public_wording: No quantified portfolio claim is currently approved by this matrix unless it resolves to a listed reproducible artifact.
rows.gap: Several career-collateral drafts that previously carried unverified quantified claims were removed from the repository (public docs remediation); the remaining case study still lacks a reproducible artifact.

rows.requirement: Production readiness, adoption, performance leadership, and model intelligence claims are gated by a released evidence bundle.

evidence.locator: live dogfood COMPLETE receipt for BOD-225 producer provenance

rows.verification: Run the release checklist against an exact tagged artifact and attach the resulting bundle and CI records.
rows.public_wording: The repository defines release evidence gates; the current checkout is not authorized to claim all gates passed.
rows.gap: An exact released artifact, signed/checksummed bundle, and complete gate report are still required.

rows.requirement: Local memory and code-graph components have explicit offline-oriented contracts and tests.

evidence.locator: restart, scope, export, and integrity tests

rows.public_wording: The repository contains tested local memory and code-graph components with explicit scope and offline-oriented behavior.
rows.gap: This local contract evidence does not verify the separate quantitative performance claims in the portfolio documents.

rows.requirement: Blocking security and privacy jobs are defined for PR/main; mandatory tag-release linkage to exact successful checks is not established.

evidence.locator: blocking bandit, pip-audit, and npm audit steps with no continue-on-error
asserts security workflow keeps non-advisory audits and required CodeQL/OSV gates
memory-plane boundary, PII redaction, evidence-schema parity, supply-chain evidence tests
end-to-end verification steps for the launch gate

rows.public_wording: Blocking static security and privacy checks are defined for PR/main. Mandatory security/privacy dependency for every tagged release and exact successful release checks remain unverified.
rows.gap: security.yml runs PR/push/schedule and release.yml needs acceptance and an optional certification gate, not mandatory SAST/dependency/CodeQL jobs. No exact tagged-release security check packet or dynamic scan is retained.

rows.requirement: Supervisor detects controller-progress stalls, restarts the controller generation, resumes validated nodes and retries unfinished or abandoned work.

evidence.locator: Supervisor controller-progress stall detection and restart
live worker failover and controller resume narrative
injected and real worker faults, cooldowns, reassignments, RESUMED
COMPLETE receipt with integrity digest after resume

rows.public_wording: Supervisor-driven recovery detects controller-progress stalls, preserves validated nodes and retries unfinished work.
rows.gap: Stall-injection proof uses a two-node graph; the BOD-225 three-node live run separately records resume and reuse of one then three validated nodes. Recorded reviewer PASS does not by itself prove semantic review coverage.

rows.requirement: Context packs track required facts; unsatisfied facts force partial status and are named in the pack state.
rows.public_wording: Context coverage contracts enforce named required-fact satisfaction before hydrated status is granted.
rows.gap: Fact satisfaction uses substring matching; semantic equivalence is not checked.

rows.requirement: When VERDICT_MULTI_STORY=on, the governor serializes overlapping-footprint stories, defers beyond cap, and excludes manual-label nodes.
rows.public_wording: When VERDICT_MULTI_STORY=on, multi-story admission serializes file-overlapping work and respects concurrency caps.
rows.gap: The feature is off by default; tests use synthetic footprints and real overlap detection depends on planner accuracy.

rows.requirement: Node-level outcome records derive aggregate usage from run evidence; separate attempt logs reject ambiguous request IDs.

evidence.locator: receipt verifies event digest but not outcome JSONL sidecar

rows.public_wording: Node-level records include aggregate tokens, status, and reported/unknown costs; a separate per-attempt spend log rejects ambiguous request IDs.
rows.gap: The outcome JSONL sidecar has no digest and is not covered by the run receipt event digest. Unknown costs remain explicit; no independent billing cross-check exists.

rows.requirement: Provider quota and context-length failures support bounded same-node recovery; provider failures can have cooldowns while context overflow is request-scoped.

evidence.locator: FailureIntelligence.classify, request-scoped context overflow, and provider cooldown classification
recorded live reassignments after injected quota and real timeout/no-final-answer

rows.public_wording: Dynamic assignment handles quota and context-length failures and fails closed on pool exhaustion. Context overflow itself does not impose provider cooldown.
rows.gap: The BOD-225 retained events show live multi-provider/route failover after injected rate limit, timeout, and no-final-answer. A live context-overflow chain has not been retained.

rows.requirement: One live orchestrate run supervises two different worker harnesses (Prime Agent headless and the direct gateway) in the same controller session, and records the harness per attempt in events, receipt and cockpit.

evidence.locator: MixedExecutor (per-node harness routing; preserves each delegate's harness)
live run 20260930T222758Z: node-1 prime-headless, node-2 direct-gateway, review PASS on cx/gpt-5.5, receipt COMPLETE integrity OK

rows.public_wording: One live Verdict run supervised two worker harnesses (Prime Agent headless and the direct gateway) in the same cockpit, with the harness recorded per attempt.
rows.gap: Both nodes succeeded first try on the same selected route, so cross-harness failover is not exercised; node-2's direct-gateway attempt reported a model without the provider prefix, so its provider-qualified identity is unverified (recorded as a route-identity mismatch).

source_scope: Claims reviewed against the audited source revision; historical execution evidence remains tied to its original run and is not proof of execution at this source revision.
